newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: SIMEX Brent marginally weaker amid thin trade.
newsitem.headline: SIMEX Brent marginally weaker amid thin trade.

text.p: August Brent futures traded marginally lower on Friday, after sharp falls in London's IPE.
August Brent on SIMEX was closed at $18.20, down just one cent from the London close, which saw a massive fall of 71 cents to $18.21.
Brokers said late trading in Asia was limited, despite earlier expectations that the shorter trading hours at NYMEX would stimulate trading on SIMEX Brent as an alternative.
But brokers were also optimistic that levels were more likely to move up rather than down, since it resisted the trendline support of $18.18.
NYMEX was shut due to the Fourth of July holiday in the US, with August closed at $19.56.
